disposition_reason: Al, As, B, Cd, Fe, Hg, Mg, Na, Pb and Zn were measured in 93 barbari, lavash and tafton breads from 93 Isfahan bakeries (GF-AAS, hydride AAS, ICP-OES); Tables 2-3 give min, max and mean ± SD on a dry-weight basis.

study.design: Bakery survey (31 per bread type, one per bakery) with Latin hypercube risk simulation
study.market: bakeries in different districts of Isfahan, Iran
study.method: Oven-dried 50 °C 48 h; microwave digestion HNO3/HCl/H2O2; GF-AAS for Pb and Cd, hydride AAS for As and Hg, ICP-OES for other elements; duplicates
lod: ICP-OES LODs 1.6 × 10-5 to 2.1 × 10-2 mg/L (Table 1); AAS LODs not tabulated
study.qa: Recoveries 92-102% (Table 1, ICP-OES elements); calibration blanks and ICV/CCV; no CRM named
